title: Diminishing returns of electrode count, epoch duration, and model complexity in EEG brain-state classification
description:
A reproducible pipeline measuring the marginal value of electrode count, recording window length, and model complexity for eyes-open versus eyes-closed classification from resting-state EEG, using the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset (109 adults, 64 channels, 160 Hz).

All validation is participant-level. The repository includes a deliberate epoch-level baseline that quantifies the inflation caused by that common error, a 41-test suite with a permuted-label negative control, and the numerical results underlying every value reported in the accompanying manuscript.
notes: Independent research project, not affiliated with or funded by any institution. Analysis of a public dataset; no new recordings were made.
